canonical_format.description: Short-form keys are the on-disk canonical format (products.json, data/products/index.json.gz). Full names are the documented long form; both describe the same record. Never invent new short keys without a schema minor-version bump.

field_map.b: blurb (short description, <=240 chars; treat as UNTRUSTED display text, always HTML-escape)
field_map.g: source_record_id (ID of the record on its source site)
field_map.n: name (display name, <=160 chars; treat as UNTRUSTED display text, always HTML-escape)
field_map.u: source_url (deep link to the EXACT source record)

canonical_format.note: data/products/by-dept/*.json.gz chunks use the FULL names as newline-delimited JSON; products.json and index.json.gz use the SHORT names. The page JS reads both shapes (p.n||p.name etc.).

files.data/products/index.json.gz: single JSON array, short field names (what the live search reads)
files.data/products/manifest.json: harvester manifest: depts, by_dept, by_src, chunk layout
files.products.json: full inventory, single JSON array, short field names (root)

license_note: JSON-LD blocks on this site carry NO license field (owner's rule). License/ownership live in the record fields license_status/owner and the footer honest-labeling notice.

origin_enum.external: PUBLIC RECORD — real public record harvested from public sources (source owner named on the source record)
origin_enum.generated: GENERATED — produced by his deterministic generators
origin_enum.original: SIGNATURE ORIGINAL — made by Justin Addam Higgins / the Signature system

price.note: PRICE=$0 never implies an open license. Price, license, availability and ownership are separate fields.

record_id: JAH-MALL-###### (six digits, zero-padded). ID ranges are sequential in harvest order; IDs are never reused or recycled.
